# THIS = a state. local_var:te_dg_g = the age group (demographics_params.GROUPS); sets
# te_dg_qf / te_dg_qm (death probability a year per 100,000), te_dg_asfr (share of a
# lifetime's births at each single age, per 100,000) and te_dg_next_group (the next
# group's first age) from the cause multipliers te_dg_m_inf, te_dg_m_work_f,
# te_dg_m_work_m, te_dg_m_ext and te_dg_m_chr (te_demog_prepare).

	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_g <= 15 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_g <= 7 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_g <= 3 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_g <= 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_g <= 0 }
						set_local_variable = {
							name = te_dg_qf
							value = {
								value = local_var:te_dg_m_inf
								multiply = 19000
								add = {
									value = local_var:te_dg_m_ext
									multiply = 60
								}
								max = 100000
							}
						}
						set_local_variable = {
							name = te_dg_qm

# THIS = a state. Writes the running band sums into band local_var:te_dg_band.
te_demog_flush_band = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 0 }
						set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf0 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
						set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm0 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
					}
					else = {
						set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf1 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
						set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm1 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf2 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm2 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 3 }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf3 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm3 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf4 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm4 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 5 }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf5 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm5 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf6 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm6 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 7 }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf7 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm7 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf8 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm8 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 13 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 11 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 10 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 9 }
						set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf9 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
						set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm9 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
					}
					else = {
						set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf10 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
						set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm10 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf11 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm11 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 12 }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf12 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm12 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf13 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm13 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 15 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 14 }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf14 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm14 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf15 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm15 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_band <= 16 }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf16 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm16 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bf17 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bf }
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_bm17 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_bm }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# THIS = a state. Writes the running class sums into class local_var:te_dg_cls.
te_demog_flush_class = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_cls <= 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_cls <= 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_cls <= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_dg_cf0 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_cf }
				set_variable = { name = te_dg_cm0 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_cm }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = te_dg_cf1 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_cf }
				set_variable = { name = te_dg_cm1 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_cm }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cf2 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_cf }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cm2 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_cm }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_cls <= 3 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cf3 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_cf }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cm3 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_cm }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cf4 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_cf }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cm4 value = local_var:te_dg_acc_cm }
		}
	}
}

# THIS = a state. On entering the migrant class of local_var:te_dg_acls (the class of the
# RATE age, a - 1): the share of the class's arrivals (te_dg_mig_gain_f / _m) and departures
# (te_dg_mig_frac_f / _m) that falls on one cohort of it, from the profile (te_dg_pf<c> /
# te_dg_pm<c>), te_dg_mig_in / te_dg_mig_out and last year's class sums. Both are zero for a
# class whose last-year sum is under one person.
te_demog_enter_class = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_acls <= 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_acls <= 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_acls <= 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_dg_cf0 >= 1 }
					set_local_variable = {
						name = te_dg_mig_gain_f
						value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_in multiply = local_var:te_dg_pf0 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf0 min = 1 } }
					}
					set_local_variable = {
						name = te_dg_mig_frac_f
						value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_out multiply = local_var:te_dg_pf0 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf0 min = 1 } }
					}
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_dg_cm0 >= 1 }
					set_local_variable = {
						name = te_dg_mig_gain_m
						value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_in multiply = local_var:te_dg_pm0 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cm0 min = 1 } }
					}
					set_local_variable = {
						name = te_dg_mig_frac_m
						value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_out multiply = local_var:te_dg_pm0 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cm0 min = 1 } }
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_dg_cf1 >= 1 }
					set_local_variable = {
						name = te_dg_mig_gain_f
						value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_in multiply = local_var:te_dg_pf1 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf1 min = 1 } }
					}
					set_local_variable = {
						name = te_dg_mig_frac_f
						value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_out multiply = local_var:te_dg_pf1 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf1 min = 1 } }
					}
				}
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_dg_cm1 >= 1 }
					set_local_variable = {
						name = te_dg_mig_gain_m
						value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_in multiply = local_var:te_dg_pm1 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cm1 min = 1 } }
					}
					set_local_variable = {
						name = te_dg_mig_frac_m
						value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_out multiply = local_var:te_dg_pm1 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cm1 min = 1 } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cf2 >= 1 }
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_gain_f
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_in multiply = local_var:te_dg_pf2 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf2 min = 1 } }
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_frac_f
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_out multiply = local_var:te_dg_pf2 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf2 min = 1 } }
				}
			}
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cm2 >= 1 }
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_gain_m
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_in multiply = local_var:te_dg_pm2 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cm2 min = 1 } }
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_frac_m
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_out multiply = local_var:te_dg_pm2 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cm2 min = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_acls <= 3 }
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cf3 >= 1 }
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_gain_f
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_in multiply = local_var:te_dg_pf3 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf3 min = 1 } }
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_frac_f
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_out multiply = local_var:te_dg_pf3 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf3 min = 1 } }
				}
			}
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cm3 >= 1 }
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_gain_m
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_in multiply = local_var:te_dg_pm3 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cm3 min = 1 } }
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_frac_m
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_out multiply = local_var:te_dg_pm3 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cm3 min = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cf4 >= 1 }
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_gain_f
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_in multiply = local_var:te_dg_pf4 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf4 min = 1 } }
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_frac_f
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_out multiply = local_var:te_dg_pf4 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf4 min = 1 } }
				}
			}
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cm4 >= 1 }
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_gain_m
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_in multiply = local_var:te_dg_pm4 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cm4 min = 1 } }
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = te_dg_mig_frac_m
					value = { value = local_var:te_dg_mig_out multiply = local_var:te_dg_pm4 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cm4 min = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# THIS = a state, seed only. local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 = population x 100,000 / the raw ring's total.
# Turns every slot of the raw ring (radix 100,000) into people: x te_dg_norm_e5, then / 100000.
te_demog_normalize_slots = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f0 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f0 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f0 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_m0 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m0 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m0 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f1 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f1 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f1 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_m1 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m1 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m1 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f2 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f2 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f2 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_m2 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m2 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m2 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f3 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f3 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f3 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_m3 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m3 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m3 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f4 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f4 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f4 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_m4 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m4 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m4 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f5 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f5 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_m5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m5 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m5 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f6 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f6 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f6 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_m6 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m6 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m6 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f7 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f7 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f7 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_m7 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m7 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m7 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f8 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f8 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f8 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_m8 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m8 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m8 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f9 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f9 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f9 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_m9 }

		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m9 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f10 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f10 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f10 divide = 100000 }

	if = {

		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m10 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f11 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f11 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f11 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {

	}
	if = {

	if = {

		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m15 divide = 100000 }

	if = {

		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f16 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {

		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m16 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f17 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f17 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f18 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f18 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f18 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_m18 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m18 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_m18 divide = 100000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_f19 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f19 multiply = local_var:te_dg_norm_e5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_dg_f19 divide = 100000 }

# THIS = a state. The life table over the age groups in order (demographics_model.life_table),
# plus the NRR's survival-weighted fertility sum. Needs te_dg_m_* (te_demog_prepare).
te_demog_life_table = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lf value = 100000 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lm value = 100000 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pyf value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pym value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_nrr_sum value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g value = 0 }
	te_demog_enter_group = yes
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_imr value = { value = local_var:te_dg_qf add = local_var:te_dg_qm divide = 200 } }
	te_demog_lt_group = { N = 1 FERTILE = no }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g value = 1 }
	te_demog_enter_group = yes
	te_demog_lt_group = { N = 4 FERTILE = no }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g value = 2 }
	te_demog_enter_group = yes
	te_demog_lt_group = { N = 5 FERTILE = no }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g value = 3 }
	te_demog_enter_group = yes
	te_demog_lt_group = { N = 5 FERTILE = no }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g value = 4 }
	te_demog_enter_group = yes

	te_demog_lt_group = { N = 5 FERTILE = no }

# THIS = a state. local_var:te_dg_nrr -> local_var:te_dg_d = NRR^(-1/29), the stable
# population's yearly factor (demographics_model.growth_factor), linear between knots.
te_demog_set_growth_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_nrr <= 0.2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_d value = 1.05707 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_nrr >= 4.0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_d value = 0.95332 }
	}
	else = {
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_dg_knot
			value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 0.2 multiply = 10 floor = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 18 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 9 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 4 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 2 }
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 1 }
							if = {
								limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 0 }
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 0.2 multiply = -0.14677 add = 1.05707 }
								}
							}
							else = {
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 0.3 multiply = -0.10289 add = 1.04239 }
								}
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 0.4 multiply = -0.07911 add = 1.0321 }
							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 3 }
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 0.5 multiply = -0.06419 add = 1.02419 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 0.6 multiply = -0.05396 add = 1.01777 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 7 }
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 6 }
							if = {
								limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 5 }
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 0.7 multiply = -0.04651 add = 1.01238 }
								}
							}
							else = {
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 0.8 multiply = -0.04085 add = 1.00772 }
								}
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 0.9 multiply = -0.0364 add = 1.00364 }
							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 8 }
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 1.0 multiply = -0.03281 add = 1 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 1.1 multiply = -0.02986 add = 0.99672 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 14 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 12 }
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 11 }
							if = {
								limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 10 }
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 1.2 multiply = -0.02739 add = 0.99373 }
								}
							}
							else = {
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 1.3 multiply = -0.02529 add = 0.99099 }
								}
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 1.4 multiply = -0.02349 add = 0.98846 }
							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 13 }
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 1.5 multiply = -0.02192 add = 0.98612 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 1.6 multiply = -0.02055 add = 0.98392 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 16 }
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 15 }
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 1.7 multiply = -0.01933 add = 0.98187 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 1.8 multiply = -0.01825 add = 0.97994 }
							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 17 }
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 1.9 multiply = -0.01728 add = 0.97811 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 2.0 multiply = -0.01641 add = 0.97638 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 28 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 23 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 21 }
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 20 }
							if = {
								limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 19 }
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 2.1 multiply = -0.01562 add = 0.97474 }
								}
							}
							else = {
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 2.2 multiply = -0.01491 add = 0.97318 }
								}
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 2.3 multiply = -0.01425 add = 0.97169 }
							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 22 }
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 2.4 multiply = -0.01365 add = 0.97026 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 2.5 multiply = -0.01309 add = 0.9689 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 26 }
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 25 }
							if = {
								limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 24 }
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 2.6 multiply = -0.01258 add = 0.96759 }
								}
							}
							else = {
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 2.7 multiply = -0.01211 add = 0.96633 }
								}
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 2.8 multiply = -0.01167 add = 0.96512 }
							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 27 }
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 2.9 multiply = -0.01126 add = 0.96395 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 3.0 multiply = -0.01088 add = 0.96283 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 33 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 31 }
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 30 }
							if = {
								limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 29 }
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 3.1 multiply = -0.01052 add = 0.96174 }
								}
							}
							else = {
								set_local_variable = {
									name = te_dg_d
									value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 3.2 multiply = -0.01019 add = 0.96069 }
								}
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 3.3 multiply = -0.00987 add = 0.95967 }
							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 32 }
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 3.4 multiply = -0.00958 add = 0.95868 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 3.5 multiply = -0.0093 add = 0.95772 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 35 }
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 34 }
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 3.6 multiply = -0.00904 add = 0.95679 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 3.7 multiply = -0.00879 add = 0.95589 }
							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { local_var:te_dg_knot <= 36 }
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 3.8 multiply = -0.00855 add = 0.95501 }
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = te_dg_d
								value = { value = local_var:te_dg_nrr subtract = 3.9 multiply = -0.00833 add = 0.95415 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# THIS = a state, ROOT = its owner on the yearly country pulse: add the state's bands.
te_demog_add_bands_to_root = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = var:te_dg_bf0 }
	root = { change_variable = { name = te_dg_cbf0 add = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = var:te_dg_bm0 }
	root = { change_variable = { name = te_dg_cbm0 add = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = var:te_dg_bf1 }
	root = { change_variable = { name = te_dg_cbf1 add = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = var:te_dg_bm1 }
	root = { change_variable = { name = te_dg_cbm1 add = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = var:te_dg_bf2 }
	root = { change_variable = { name = te_dg_cbf2 add = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = var:te_dg_bm2 }
	root = { change_variable = { name = te_dg_cbm2 add = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = var:te_dg_bf3 }
	root = { change_variable = { name = te_dg_cbf3 add = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = var:te_dg_bm3 }
	root = { change_variable = { name = te_dg_cbm3 add = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = var:te_dg_bf4 }

	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = var:te_dg_bm17 }
	root = { change_variable = { name = te_dg_cbm17 add = local_var:te_dg_t } }

# THIS = a country: zero its band sums before the states add theirs.
te_demog_reset_country_bands = {
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbf0 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbm0 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbf1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbm1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbf2 value = 0 }

# THIS = a pop in the walk: its people and its income into its wealth band. The knots are each
# band's top (1, then every fifth level to 195; the last band runs to the top level, 200),
# split in halves, so a pop takes five or six tests. The leaf computes the income: spending per
# head (buy package / 100), linear across the band, uncapped. It is summed in units of 100,000:
# the people divide first (exact), so the largest country at the top level fits the fixed point
# (i64 x 1e-5); the smallest step is 1 of spending per pop.
te_demog_gini_band_add = {
	if = {
		limit = { wealth > 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { wealth > 150 }
			if = {
				limit = { wealth > 175 }
				if = {
					limit = { wealth > 190 }
					if = {
						limit = { wealth > 195 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn41 add = total_size }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy41 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth max = 200 subtract = 195 multiply = 54543667.118 add = 682033739.68 } } }
					}
					else = {
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn40 add = total_size }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy40 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 190 multiply = 39794137.81 add = 483063050.63 } } }
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { wealth > 185 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn39 add = total_size }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy39 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 185 multiply = 28797833.162 add = 339073884.82 } } }
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { wealth > 180 }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn38 add = total_size }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy38 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 180 multiply = 20662449.292 add = 235761638.36 } } }
						}
						else = {
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn37 add = total_size }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy37 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 175 multiply = 14692176.806 add = 162300754.33 } } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { wealth > 165 }
					if = {
						limit = { wealth > 170 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn36 add = total_size }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy36 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 170 multiply = 10348044.494 add = 110560531.86 } } }
					}
					else = {
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn35 add = total_size }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy35 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 165 multiply = 7215501.42 add = 74483024.76 } } }
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { wealth > 160 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn34 add = total_size }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy34 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 160 multiply = 4978062.158 add = 49592713.97 } } }
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { wealth > 155 }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn33 add = total_size }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy33 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 155 multiply = 3396006.83 add = 32612679.82 } } }
						}
						else = {
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn32 add = total_size }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy32 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 150 multiply = 2289272.902 add = 21166315.31 } } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { wealth > 125 }
				if = {
					limit = { wealth > 140 }
					if = {
						limit = { wealth > 145 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn31 add = total_size }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy31 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 145 multiply = 1523804.05 add = 13547295.06 } } }
					}
					else = {

					}
				}

					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { wealth > 30 }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn8 add = total_size }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy8 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 30 multiply = 5.074 add = 29.07 } } }
						}
						else = {
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn7 add = total_size }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy7 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 25 multiply = 2.602 add = 16.06 } } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { wealth > 10 }
					if = {
						limit = { wealth > 20 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn6 add = total_size }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy6 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 20 multiply = 1.326 add = 9.43 } } }
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { wealth > 15 }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn5 add = total_size }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy5 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 15 multiply = 0.714 add = 5.86 } } }
						}
						else = {
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn4 add = total_size }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy4 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 10 multiply = 0.448 add = 3.62 } } }
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { wealth > 5 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn3 add = total_size }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy3 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 5 multiply = 0.282 add = 2.21 } } }
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = { wealth > 1 }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn2 add = total_size }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy2 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = { value = wealth subtract = 1 multiply = 0.175 add = 1.51 } } }
						}
						else = {
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gn1 add = total_size }
							change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w_gy1 add = { value = total_size divide = 100000 multiply = 1.51 } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# THIS = a state, after its store: its bands into the formula's locals (0 where none is stored).
te_demog_gini_band_load = {
	te_demog_gini_band_zero = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n1 value = var:te_dg_gn1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_y1 value = var:te_dg_gy1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n2 value = var:te_dg_gn2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_y2 value = var:te_dg_gy2 }

# THIS = a state in its country's loop: add its bands if they follow this layout, and count it in
# local_var:te_dg_g_states (the caller sets it to 0). A state from an older save (14 bands to 61+,
# capped income in other units, or strata sums) adds nothing until its own walk stores new ones.
te_demog_gini_band_add_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gini_layout }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_dg_gini_layout = 2 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_states add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n1 add = var:te_dg_gn1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_y1 add = var:te_dg_gy1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn2 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n2 add = var:te_dg_gn2 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_y2 add = var:te_dg_gy2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn3 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n3 add = var:te_dg_gn3 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_y3 add = var:te_dg_gy3 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn4 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n4 add = var:te_dg_gn4 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_y4 add = var:te_dg_gy4 }

				limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn5 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n5 add = var:te_dg_gn5 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_y5 add = var:te_dg_gy5 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn6 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n6 add = var:te_dg_gn6 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_y6 add = var:te_dg_gy6 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn7 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n7 add = var:te_dg_gn7 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_y7 add = var:te_dg_gy7 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn8 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n8 add = var:te_dg_gn8 }

			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn31 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n31 add = var:te_dg_gn31 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_y31 add = var:te_dg_gy31 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn32 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_n32 add = var:te_dg_gn32 }

# THIS = a state or a country, with its bands in te_dg_g_n<k> and te_dg_g_y<k> (a country's summed
# over its states, so its Gini is taken over all their people, not averaged). The bands are in
# income order, so G = 1 - sum p_k (S_k + S_k-1), with p_k a band's share of people and S_k the
# running share of income. Values are i64 x 1e-5: each S_k is the income so far over the total, cut
# once, and the people multiply it before the one division by all people, so no share of a few
# people is cut to 0. Empty bands are skipped. With no people or no income the computed Gini is 0.
# Writes var:te_dg_gini, the panel's figure: 1 - 0.7 x (1 - G), the equality the bands show
# scaled down for the spread inside them (spec 4.1; owner, 2026-10-10), so it reads like historians'
# estimates.
te_demog_gini_from_locals = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_pop value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_inc value = 0 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_pop add = local_var:te_dg_g_n1 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_inc add = local_var:te_dg_g_y1 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_pop add = local_var:te_dg_g_n2 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_inc add = local_var:te_dg_g_y2 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_pop add = local_var:te_dg_g_n3 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_inc add = local_var:te_dg_g_y3 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_pop add = local_var:te_dg_g_n4 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_inc add = local_var:te_dg_g_y4 }

	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g_gini value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_dg_g_pop > 0
			local_var:te_dg_g_inc > 0
		}

# THIS = a state. The migrant profile (demographics_model.migrant_profile): from the kinds'
# weights te_dg_labour, te_dg_family, te_dg_refugee and labour's women's share
# te_dg_labour_f, each class's share for women (te_dg_pf<c>) and men (te_dg_pm<c>).
te_demog_set_profile = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pf0 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_labour multiply = 0 multiply = local_var:te_dg_labour_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_family multiply = 0.175 } add = { value = local_var:te_dg_refugee multiply = 0.135 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pm0 value = { value = 1 subtract = local_var:te_dg_labour_f multiply = local_var:te_dg_labour multiply = 0 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_family multiply = 0.175 } add = { value = local_var:te_dg_refugee multiply = 0.135 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pf1 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_labour multiply = 0.05 multiply = local_var:te_dg_labour_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_family multiply = 0.025 } add = { value = local_var:te_dg_refugee multiply = 0.025 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pm1 value = { value = 1 subtract = local_var:te_dg_labour_f multiply = local_var:te_dg_labour multiply = 0.05 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_family multiply = 0.025 } add = { value = local_var:te_dg_refugee multiply = 0.025 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pf2 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_labour multiply = 0.9 multiply = local_var:te_dg_labour_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_family multiply = 0.175 } add = { value = local_var:te_dg_refugee multiply = 0.15 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pm2 value = { value = 1 subtract = local_var:te_dg_labour_f multiply = local_var:te_dg_labour multiply = 0.9 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_family multiply = 0.175 } add = { value = local_var:te_dg_refugee multiply = 0.15 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pf3 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_labour multiply = 0.05 multiply = local_var:te_dg_labour_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_family multiply = 0.11 } add = { value = local_var:te_dg_refugee multiply = 0.125 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pm3 value = { value = 1 subtract = local_var:te_dg_labour_f multiply = local_var:te_dg_labour multiply = 0.05 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_family multiply = 0.11 } add = { value = local_var:te_dg_refugee multiply = 0.125 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pf4 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_labour multiply = 0 multiply = local_var:te_dg_labour_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_family multiply = 0.015 } add = { value = local_var:te_dg_refugee multiply = 0.065 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_pm4 value = { value = 1 subtract = local_var:te_dg_labour_f multiply = local_var:te_dg_labour multiply = 0 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_family multiply = 0.015 } add = { value = local_var:te_dg_refugee multiply = 0.065 } } }
}

# THIS = a state or a country; $B$ = the band variables' prefix (te_dg_b or te_dg_cb).
# Sets locals te_dg_total, te_dg_young, te_dg_working, te_dg_old (0-14, 15-64, 65+),
# te_dg_w1549 (women 15-49), te_dg_w2059 and te_dg_m2059 (20-59), then te_dg_median.
te_demog_band_figures = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_total value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_young value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_working value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_old value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w1549 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w2059 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_m2059 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = { value = var:$B$f0 add = var:$B$m0 } }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_total add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_young add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = { value = var:$B$f1 add = var:$B$m1 } }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_total add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_young add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = { value = var:$B$f2 add = var:$B$m2 } }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_total add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_young add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = { value = var:$B$f3 add = var:$B$m3 } }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_total add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_working add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w1549 add = var:$B$f3 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = { value = var:$B$f4 add = var:$B$m4 } }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_total add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_working add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w1549 add = var:$B$f4 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w2059 add = var:$B$f4 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_m2059 add = var:$B$m4 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = { value = var:$B$f5 add = var:$B$m5 } }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_total add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_working add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w1549 add = var:$B$f5 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w2059 add = var:$B$f5 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_m2059 add = var:$B$m5 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = { value = var:$B$f6 add = var:$B$m6 } }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_total add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_working add = local_var:te_dg_t }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w1549 add = var:$B$f6 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_w2059 add = var:$B$f6 }

# THIS = a country (the player's). From the country's band sums te_dg_cb* and its average
# rates (te_dg_m_* locals, local_var:te_dg_tfr): te_dg_pjf<b> / te_dg_pjm<b>, the bands
# twenty years ahead. Five-year survival per band from its age group; births from women
# 15-49 at their group's fertility. A display outline, not the model's step.
te_demog_project = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g value = 1 }
	te_demog_enter_group = yes
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sf0 value = { value = 1 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_qf divide = 100000 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = local_var:te_dg_sf0 }
	while = { count = 4 change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sf0 multiply = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sm0 value = { value = 1 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_qm divide = 100000 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = local_var:te_dg_sm0 }
	while = { count = 4 change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sm0 multiply = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fert0 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_asfr multiply = 5 divide = 100000 multiply = local_var:te_dg_tfr } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_xf0 value = var:te_dg_cbf0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_xm0 value = var:te_dg_cbm0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g value = 2 }
	te_demog_enter_group = yes
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sf1 value = { value = 1 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_qf divide = 100000 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = local_var:te_dg_sf1 }
	while = { count = 4 change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sf1 multiply = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sm1 value = { value = 1 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_qm divide = 100000 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = local_var:te_dg_sm1 }
	while = { count = 4 change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sm1 multiply = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fert1 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_asfr multiply = 5 divide = 100000 multiply = local_var:te_dg_tfr } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_xf1 value = var:te_dg_cbf1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_xm1 value = var:te_dg_cbm1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g value = 3 }
	te_demog_enter_group = yes
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sf2 value = { value = 1 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_qf divide = 100000 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = local_var:te_dg_sf2 }
	while = { count = 4 change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sf2 multiply = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sm2 value = { value = 1 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_qm divide = 100000 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = local_var:te_dg_sm2 }
	while = { count = 4 change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sm2 multiply = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fert2 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_asfr multiply = 5 divide = 100000 multiply = local_var:te_dg_tfr } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_xf2 value = var:te_dg_cbf2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_xm2 value = var:te_dg_cbm2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_g value = 4 }
	te_demog_enter_group = yes
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sf3 value = { value = 1 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_qf divide = 100000 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = local_var:te_dg_sf3 }
	while = { count = 4 change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sf3 multiply = local_var:te_dg_t } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_sm3 value = { value = 1 subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_qm divide = 100000 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_t value = local_var:te_dg_sm3 }

	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fert3 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_asfr multiply = 5 divide = 100000 multiply = local_var:te_dg_tfr } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_xf3 value = var:te_dg_cbf3 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_xm3 value = var:te_dg_cbm3 }
